metric_definitions.mean: average three seeds within each subject, then average 18 subjects
metric_definitions.std: sample SD (ddof=1) of the 18 subject means, not a confidence interval
metric_definitions.concatenated_macro_f1: concatenate 18 held-out sequences within each seed, then average the three scores

diagnostic_scope: Frozen-parent inference interventions, not separately retrained ablations.
boundary_jitter: Shift all internal Round-0 boundaries by +/-1 and +/-2 feature-grid steps; clamp to preserve nonempty segments. Average frame L2, signed shifts, seeds, then subjects.
example_selection: Retain the subjects and seed from the previous displayed examples; no selection from new final-model performance.
